update_statistics.gradient_norm_semantics: Pre-clipping global norm returned by clip_grad_norm_.
update_statistics.component_loss_semantics: Each TD, supervised hinge and active MC-return term is separately averaged over 117 rows. The total is their sum, without division by three.
update_statistics.comparison_warning: The combined objectives differ; compare their shared TD/margin diagnostics, return RMSE and physical outcomes separately. Later target networks evolve separately.
update_statistics.mc_log_availability: The new treatment records its active MC loss before and after every update.
update_statistics.td_target_return_gap_semantics: Frozen pre-update one-step Bellman target minus the fixed actual demonstration return, evaluated in float64. At a target synchronization this is the old target generation, not the saved post-update target network.

sampled_retention.interpretation: Matched known-scene observations from one inherited initialization; historical control episodes are reused, not newly executed or independent generalization trials.
sampled_retention.baseline_origin: Verified attempt-016 baseline, reused without new training or episodes.

paired_dense_rankings.interpretation: Improvements and regressions refer to demonstration-action rankings on matched reference inputs, not inferred physical successes or failures.

first_update_objective_comparison.scope: The first objective differs only by the coefficient-one MC term; later optimization paths and target values evolve separately.

limitations: Only the ongoing fixed-return Huber term is added; all demonstration coefficients remain one, with denominator117 per term.
The control's 8000 updates and 87 episodes are historical reused evidence, not new attempt-017 computation.
Actual demonstration returns describe the demonstration policy and are not assumed to be optimal Q values.
Dense reference-state rank changes do not imply measured episode failure, particularly after a trajectory leaves the shared prefix.
Three known scenes and one initialization do not establish held-out generalization or online learning.
This analyzer performs no environment reset, environment step, optimizer update or forced-action rescue.
